title: Same street, day into night
technique: first + last frame, the last frame made as an edit of the first
style: Photorealistic, 35mm lens, eye-level, static tripod framing.

keyframes.prompt: A narrow cobbled street in an old European town at midday, cafe tables on the left, flower boxes under the windows, a bicycle leaning on a lamppost. 16:9 composition.

The same street, same framing and every object in the same place, now at blue hour: warm lights on in the windows and the lamppost, cafe tables lit by string lights, wet cobbles reflecting the lights. 16:9 composition.

shots.video_prompt: Time-lapse from midday to blue hour on a fixed camera. Shadows stretch and cross the street, the sky cools, windows and the lamppost light up one by one, a few passers-by blur through. Light city ambience, a distant church bell near the end.
